description: Progressive enhancement for footnotes: collects the <foot-note> elements that precede it into a labelled doc-endnotes list (or margin sidenotes), with doc-noteref references, doc-backlink return links, shared notes for repeat citations and a hover/focus preview.

attributes.name: data-mode
attributes.description: Omit for a collected notes list; "sidenotes" places each note in the margin beside its reference (notes with data-side="false" still go to the list). Observed: changing it re-renders.

attributes.name: data-label-back
attributes.description: Accessible name of the backlinks; a note cited several times gets " (a)", " (b)" … appended. Observed at runtime.

attributes.name: data-label-ref
attributes.description: Accessible name of each reference link; {n} is replaced by the note number. Observed at runtime.

attributes.name: data-label-heading
attributes.description: Text of the generated, visually hidden heading that labels the doc-endnotes section. Ignored when the author supplies a heading child (h1–h6), which is used as the label instead. Observed at runtime.

attributes.name: data-preview
attributes.description: "false" disables the hover / keyboard-focus preview popover on references. Observed at runtime.

childAttributes.name: data-side
childAttributes.description: "false" opts a note out of sidenote placement in data-mode="sidenotes"; it is collected into the list instead.

childAttributes.name: data-ref
childAttributes.description: Id of an earlier or later <foot-note> collected by the same <foot-notes>: this element becomes another citation of that note (no content of its own) and the note gets one backlink per citation (a, b, …).

structure.description: Inline note anywhere BEFORE the <foot-notes> in document order (not necessarily a child). Phrasing content; without JS it renders in parentheses. Enhanced: its content nodes are moved (not copied) into the note, and it holds a superscript <a role="doc-noteref"> (id fnref-I-N, fnref-I-N-b for repeat citations).
A heading child of <foot-notes> labels the generated <section role="doc-endnotes">; otherwise a visually hidden <h2> with data-label-heading is generated.
